description: Stop bleeding, set bones, treat infection. Your hands remember the ER. Diagnose the sick at a glance; deepened, your care turns even the severe cases.
name: Triage
synergyHints: Steady Hands: size up the wound, then work it slow and steady.

deepening.2: You diagnose at a glance — examination always succeeds, and fast.
deepening.3: BATTLEFIELD MASTER: your supportive care can turn even the severe cases, and you read any sickness at a touch — no diagnosis needed.

description: Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
name: Steady Hands

deepening.2: Your hands don't shake anymore — not ever. Delicate work is just work.
deepening.3: MASTER: your fine work teaches itself — villagers watching you learn twice as fast.

description: Read sign: tracks, scat, browse lines. You know what's been here and how long ago.
name: Game Sense
synergyHints: Patient Aim: find it, then drop it clean

actions.name: Read Sign
actions.effect: Study tracks, scat, browse lines. Learn what's been here, how long ago, which direction.

actions.name: Read Stance
actions.effect: Once per fight: study the monster's stance. Reveals its likely next move (knowledge-gated).

deepening.2: You read the land like a newspaper — yesterday and today.
deepening.3: The wild tells you its plans: you know where game WILL be.

description: One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
name: Patient Aim

actions.name: Take Aim
actions.effect: Spend turn aiming. Next shot is 2.5x damage and cannot miss. You are exposed (enemies get +hit).

actions.name: Line Up Clean Shot
actions.effect: Take extra time lining up the shot. Your next hunting strike lands more reliably — and when it lands, it's clean: the animal doesn't suffer.

deepening.2: The shot is always there. You just wait.
deepening.3: One shot, one kill: your opening strike cannot miss.

description: Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
name: Field Dressing

actions.name: Field Dress
actions.effect: Break down a carcass into usable meat plus hide, sinew, bone. Your Field Dressing skill wastes less of the carcass — this is the deliberate work of breaking it down.

deepening.2: Clean cuts, no waste — the carcass gives everything.
deepening.3: You read the animal in the dressing: its health, its range, its story.

description: You think in shelf life. Smoking, drying, salting — food that lasts is food that saves.
name: Preservation Instinct

deepening.3: You taste spoilage before it starts — nothing goes bad on your watch.

description: Your gut handles what it shouldn't. A useful lie your body tells itself.

actions.effect: Settle your gut until the next part of the day. Unsafe food can't poison you while it lasts.
actions.name: Push Through

name: Iron Stomach

deepening.2: You can eat things that would hospitalize others. Mostly.
deepening.3: Your gut is a laboratory: you can TASTE poison — one lick tells you if food is safe.

description: Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
name: Soft Step

deepening.2: You move like weather. Even twigs don't notice.
deepening.3: You can walk a sleeping camp and no one dreams of you.

description: Adrenaline hits and the world slows — you are harder to hit when it matters.
name: Adrenaline Surge

deepening.2: The slow world is home now.
deepening.3: Time stutters for you alone: once per fight, dodge the undodgeable.

synergyHints: Cornucopia: the streak rewards the devoted.
Green Whisper: they lean toward you. Lean back.
Feast Engine: the harvest becomes the weapon.
name: Green Thumb, Literally
description: Your thumb is green. Not metaphorically. Foraging yields +50%, AND you can ask a plant what's nearby (once/day: reveals this tile's forage table).
flavor: The plants lean toward you. They're gossiping. You're learning to listen.

deepening.3: You sense rich ground. Forage spots glow.

actions.name: Ask the Plants
actions.desc: Ask what's growing here. Once/day: reveals this tile's forage table.

name: Tracker
description: Hunting success +30%. You read the ground.
flavor: You see the footprints! We only see feet!

actions.name: Track
actions.effect: Follow tracks. Find where an animal went, how many, how long ago.

deepening.3: You see tracks from 2 tiles away.

name: Diplomatic Incident
description: Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
flavor: Peace is just war with better catering. You cater beautifully.

deepening.3: Villagers tell you secrets unprompted.

name: Secret Ingredient
description: Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
flavor: The System has filed seventeen complaints about your cooking. It keeps eating anyway.

name: Generous Heart
description: Donating gives 2x trust.
flavor: Sharing! We love sharing! Have our moon!

deepening.3: Your generosity is famous: donations return threefold in loyalty.

name: Scrounger
description: Ruin looting finds +1 item.
flavor: You find the shiny things in the broken places!

deepening.2: Ruins give up their secrets to you.
deepening.3: You find what others missed: picked ruins still hide one more thing.

name: Squirrel Friend
description: Squirrels sometimes leave you nuts. (Random gifts.)
flavor: The tiny tree-people like you! They pay rent in acorns!

deepening.2: The squirrels have a network, and you're in it.
deepening.3: The forest provides: gifts arrive when you need them most.

name: Rain Dancer
description: When it rains, +1L water free. (You dance. It works.)
flavor: You wiggle and the sky cries! We tried wiggling! Nothing happened!

deepening.3: You call the rain: dance, and water comes (once per week).

name: Loud Chewer
description: Eating is 2x louder (monsters hear you). But +5 morale.
flavor: CRONCH CRONCH! We love the cronch! The monsters love it too! Oops!

deepening.2: Your joy is infectious — morale spreads.
deepening.3: Your appetite is legend: the village eats better just watching you.

name: Hoarder
description: +10kg carry, but villagers trust you 20% less. (They notice.)
flavor: You keep the things! ALL the things! We... are concerned! But impressed!

deepening.2: Your stashes are everywhere. You remember all of them.
deepening.3: You never lack: once per week, produce exactly what's needed from your hoard.

name: Light Fingers
description: Steal from pantry without trust loss (50%). If caught, -20 trust.
flavor: The food disappears! Magic! (It's not magic. We saw you.)

actions.name: Light Fingers
actions.effect: Steal from the pantry. 50% chance of no trust loss. If caught: -20 trust.

deepening.3: You can steal the truth itself: learn one secret per theft.

name: Photosynthesis
description: Gain 100 kcal per daylight day part. (You're becoming a plant.)
flavor: YOU EAT THE SUN! We eat... we don't eat! But WOW!

deepening.3: You bloom: in daylight, you barely need to eat.

actions.name: Refuse
actions.effect: Once per day, when you would die: you don't. Drop to 1 HP; brought up to at least 500 kcal from sheer spite when death came violently — starvation and sickness just leave you at 1 HP, still hungry. Automatic trigger.

name: Second Wind
description: Once per day, when you'd die, you don't. (1 HP — plus 500 kcal of sheer spite when death came violently. Starvation and sickness just leave you at 1 HP, still hungry.)
flavor: You were almost gone! Then you WEREN'T! How?! We want to know!

deepening.3: Twice per day, death is refused.

name: Lucky Rock
description: Your lucky rock. The System finds your faith adorable and helps a little: +5% on the hunt. (It’s not the rock. It’s you believing in the rock.)
flavor: The rock! It is lucky! We checked! It's... a rock! But YOU believe! Belief is power! (We added 4%.)

deepening.2: The rock believes in you. That's enough.
deepening.3: Luck is a skill now: once per day, reroll any failure.

name: Bird Whisperer
description: Birds land on you. They also warn you: +20% chance to detect monsters before they detect you. (The birds see everything.)
flavor: The sky-flappers are your spies! They tell you secrets! Mostly about breadcrumbs! But sometimes about TEETH!

deepening.3: The sky watches for you: you'll always know what's coming.

name: Chitin Skin
description: Your skin hardens into plates. +30 armor, but -5 trust (you look wrong).
flavor: You are becoming the beetle! The beetle is strong! The beetle is... lonely! But strong!

deepening.2: Your plates are armor and statement.
deepening.3: Living fortress: your skin turns blades, and you feel nothing.

name: Extra Stomach
description: You grow a second stomach. Bank twice the calories — but the hunger doubles too. (It's always hungry.)
flavor: Two tummies! Twice the hunger! Twice the... we didn't think this through! But WOW!

deepening.3: You can feast for the village: share your second stomach's bounty.

name: Deep Reserves
description: Your body learns to bank calories like a war chest. Bank 5× the energy. The furnace is always lit — but it must be FED.
flavor: FIVE stomachs?! We lost count! The furnace DEMANDS tribute! FEED IT! (It's worth it. Probably.)

deepening.3: You are the reserve: in famine, your body feeds others.

name: Eyes in the Back
description: You see behind you. Can't be ambushed. But you see... things. (-5 morale when alone.)
flavor: You see the behind! We see the... we don't want to see the behind! Too many teeth!

deepening.3: You see everything: ambushes are impossible, and you see... more.

name: Molt
description: Once per week, shed your skin. Heal to full, but lose all equipped gear (it's stuck in the old skin).
flavor: You peel! Like the fruit! The new you is shiny! The old you is... leave it! Run!

actions.name: Molt
actions.effect: Shed your skin. Heal to full HP. Lose all equipped gear (stuck in old skin). Once per week.

deepening.3: You molt at will: heal to full once per week, keep your gear.

synergyHints: Feast Engine: eat yourself to feed the furnace.
Iron Gut: waste nothing. Not even yourself.
name: Blood Price
description: Spend 10 HP to gain 500 kcal. Your body eats itself. Twice per day part. The cut is missing mass — max HP drops while it’s open, knits ~10 a night, and the body refuses past 50.
flavor: You burn the red! The red becomes... lunch?! We are CONCERNED! (We checked the math twice. The math is as confused as we are.)

deepening.2: The cut is cleaner, the return richer.
deepening.3: Your blood is currency: convert HP to kcal at will, no wound.

synergyHints: Blood Frenzy: the red builds.
Haymaker: spend it all.
Trade of Blows: currency of pain.

actions.name: Unleash Rage
actions.effect: Your next 3 strikes deal +100% damage. The red comes down — hold on.

name: Berserker Rage
description: Your next 3 strikes deal +100% damage. The red comes down — hold on.
flavor: ANGRY! SO ANGRY! Three strikes of pure red! Hit the thing! THE THING! (You know the one. The one trying to kill you.)

deepening.2: The red is a tool now.
deepening.3: Perfect fury: your rage never misses and never fades mid-fight.

name: Red Hunger
description: Red Hunger: near a person-corpse, butcher and feed on the spot — through the real pipeline. Trauma, corruption, witnesses, prions: all the usual costs apply.
flavor: The hunger is LOUD! It doesn't conjure food anymore — it just knows what the dead are for, and it isn't patient about it.

deepening.3: The hunger is wise: you gain their strength, not just their meat.

name: Pact with Static
description: Gain a random overpowered ability, but lose a random utility ability. (The Static gives. The Static takes.)
flavor: You whisper to the between! It answers! It ALWAYS answers! That's the problem!

deepening.3: You renegotiate: choose which ability the pact takes.

synergyHints: Impaling Scream: stun them, then the spear finds the opening.
Haymaker: they can't dodge what they can't hear coming.
Shoulder Check: shove the stunned.
name: Scream Cheese
description: You can scream so loud it curdles milk (and stuns monsters for 1 round). 1/day.
flavor: AAAAA! The milk is cheese now! The monsters are dizzy! Your throat hurts! Worth it!

actions.name: Scream
actions.effect: Scream so loud it curdles milk. Stuns all monsters for 1 round. Once per day.

deepening.2: Your voice curdles more than milk.
deepening.3: The scream is a weapon: shatter stone, not just nerves.

synergyHints: Shattering Blow: blind them, then the machete finds the seams.
Come Get Some: blind it, then call it to you.
Ambush: they can't see the ground you picked.
name: Pocket Sand
description: Throw sand in eyes. Blinds for 2 rounds. (You always have sand. Don't ask where.)
flavor: SAND! In the eyes! It's in YOUR pocket! How?! We don't know! But it's there!

actions.name: Pocket Sand
actions.effect: Throw sand in eyes. Blinds target for 2 rounds (attacks have disadvantage). You always have sand.

deepening.2: You always have sand. Don't ask.
deepening.3: Pocket everything: sand, yes, but also keys, knives, secrets.

name: Taste Vision
description: You can taste colors. (Reveals hidden loot: +30% find chance in ruins. The walls taste like secrets.)
flavor: The red tastes like... copper! The blue tastes like... hiding places! Lick the walls!

deepening.3: You taste truth: lies have a flavor, and it's unmistakable.

name: Tainted Bait
description: Your bait is tainted — traps catch 50% more. (The poison’s in the bait, not your hands. Mostly.)
flavor: The bait is spicy now! The spicy is... death! For TRAPS! We are worried about you! But impressed!

deepening.3: Master of the tainted trap: the bait takes only what you meant it to.

actions.effect: Stand still and let them look. Each enemy hesitates — loses its next round. Villagers watching lose 5 trust.
actions.name: Loom
Menace
actions.effect: Make your point without raising a hand. They'll remember the look on your face — and not fondly. (No mechanical edge yet — the weight is social.)

name: Dread
description: Villagers and monsters are uneasy around you. -10 trust, but monsters hesitate (+1 round before attacking).
flavor: You are the scary! We are scared! The monsters are scared! Everyone is scared! ...fun!

deepening.3: Terror is a tool: you can aim your fear like a weapon.

name: Grave Robber
description: You can loot the dead (villagers, monsters). Good gear. -15 trust if seen.
flavor: The dead don't need the shiny! You need the shiny! The living... disagree!

actions.name: Rob the Dead
actions.effect: Loot a corpse thoroughly. Better gear than normal looting. -15 trust if seen doing it.

deepening.3: You speak with the dead: the looted tell you where they hid the rest.

name: Time Skip
description: Skip to the next day part instantly. Time passes — food spoils forward, calories burn, the world moves without you. 1/day.
flavor: You JUMP the time! Hours go missing! Your food is OLDER! Your belly is EMPTIER! The time had to come from SOMEWHERE! We took notes! The notes make SENSE this time!

deepening.3: You skip with precision: arrive exactly when needed.

name: Hive Mind
description: The hive opens: every tile on the map lies revealed — terrain-sense, never detail; walk a tile to truly know it. They feel you watching. (-10 trust.)
flavor: All the brains touch! It's cozy! It's invasive! It's... both! We love it!

deepening.3: You are the hive: see through every allied eye.

name: Cold-Blooded
description: You need 20% less food in cold weather. Your body budgets like an accountant.
flavor: You are the lizard! Slow! Efficient! We envy your heating bill! (You don't have one!)

deepening.3: Your blood is antifreeze: cold cannot touch you or yours.

name: Echo Location
description: Clap once: you sense the shape of the land — reveals the 3x3 world-map tiles around you. 1/day.
flavor: CLAP! The sound comes back with a MAP! You are the bat! (The bat is jealous!)

deepening.2: The world has shape in sound.
deepening.3: You see through walls: sound maps the unseen.

name: Compost King
description: Spoiled food becomes fertilizer: bury it, and forage yields +10% on that tile next season.
flavor: The rot becomes the GROWTH! Nothing is wasted! We love this one! (We eat... nothing! But still!)

deepening.3: The cycle obeys: your compost grows miracles.

name: Beard Moss
description: Moss grows in your beard/hair. You always have tinder. (Looks great, honestly.)
flavor: You are the WALKING FOREST! The moss chose YOU! Fashion AND function!

deepening.3: Living beard: your moss heals small wounds and hides you.

name: Dowsing
description: A forked stick twitches toward water. Works 70% of the time. Nobody knows why. Including us.
flavor: The stick KNOWS! We tested it! We don't understand it! Science is hard!

deepening.3: You find more than water: the stick points to what you need.

name: Cornered Rat
description: When surrounded (3+ enemies), +100% damage and +50% dodge. Desperation is a weapon.
flavor: BACK AGAINST THE WALL! Teeth BARE! We are cheering SO loud right now!

deepening.3: The corner is your throne: surrounded, you are unstoppable.

synergyHints: Patient Aim: the shot you don't take... then take.
Trophy Room: mark them, then the first shot is a promise.
Blood Trail: they don't get away. Not from this.
name: Dead Aim
description: First attack in any combat is a guaranteed critical if you waited 1 round. Patience, then thunder.
flavor: You WAIT! You BREATHE! Then — BOOM! The audience gasps! We gasped!

actions.name: Dead Aim
actions.effect: One perfect shot. 3x damage, ignores armor. You cannot move this turn.

deepening.3: Death waits with you: your held shot kills anything it hits.

name: Travel Light
description: You wear the world like weather — armor, pack, all of it. Nothing you carry slows you down: every mile costs 15% less.
flavor: You packed WHAT?! Where did it all GO?! So light! So fast! We can barely keep UP!

deepening.2: You pack light and move lighter.
deepening.3: You ARE the journey: distance shortens under your stride.

name: Open Book
description: Villagers tell you their real trust level and one secret fear. You just... know how to ask.
flavor: You ASK and they TELL! What is this power?! We want to learn it! (We can't. We tried.)

deepening.3: You read souls: one glance tells you who they are.

name: Mediator
description: You can resolve villager disputes (drama events) with a talk check. Peace is a skill.
flavor: You make the angry people UN-angry! With WORDS! We don't understand! But WOW!

actions.name: Mediate
actions.effect: Resolve a villager dispute with a talk check. Peace is a skill. Bonus from drama.resolve_bonus.

deepening.2: You can cool any temper. Anger listens to you.
deepening.3: MASTER MEDIATOR: warring parties seek you out — you end feuds, not just fights.

name: Leech
description: When an ally takes damage near you, you can take half of it. They owe you. (They know it.)
flavor: You DRINK their pain! Not literally! (Unless you want to! We won't judge!)

actions.name: Leech Stance
actions.effect: Enter leech stance: when an ally takes damage near you this round, you take half of it. They owe you. (They know it.)

deepening.3: You drink wounds: take their injuries as your strength.

name: Scarecrow
description: You can stage a fake injury to lure monsters into traps. They fall for it. Every time.
flavor: You PRETEND to be hurt! They come! TRAPPED! Devious! We LOVE it! (We're a little scared of you!)

actions.name: Stage Injury
actions.effect: Stage a fake injury to lure monsters into your traps. They fall for it. Every time. Next trap is guaranteed to trigger.

deepening.3: You become the monster they fear: traps set themselves.

name: Hollow Bones
description: You weigh 30% less for carry calculations. Your bones are birdlike. (Don't think about it.)
flavor: Your bones are HOLLOW! Like the bird! You are light! Do NOT think about why!

deepening.3: You could fly if you believed: falls can't hurt you.

name: Third Eye
description: A small eye opens on your forehead when danger is near. +30% ambush detection. It weeps when you lie.
flavor: ANOTHER EYE! It sees the danger! It also sees your LIES! (We see them too! We don't mind!)

deepening.3: The eye sees all: danger has no secrets from you.

name: Phoenix Clause
description: When you would die: the clause burns a RANDOM living villager of yours — body and all, no corpse, only ash — and you emerge from their ashes wherever they were, at 1 HP. The fire cannot take another bearer: only bearers left, and your death sticks. No villagers left, or no village, and your death sticks. Their gear survives the fire where they fell — it belongs to the village now, not to you. Pocket it and the village will judge you; bring it home to Haven and they will honor you. The devoted may offer themselves willingly; the resentful may fight the pull. Use it twice and the village will judge you: earn their love or be exiled. The cost is plain. The horror is knowing and doing it anyway.
flavor: You DIE! Then — KABOOM! — you're BACK! ...in someone else's ashes. The audience LOVED it! The ratings! THE RATINGS! (Someone's family is screaming. The ratings don't cover that.)

deepening.3: You choose who burns: the clause takes your chosen, not random.

name: Symbiote
description: A small alien organism lives in your gut. It eats 200 kcal/day. Passively: warns you of poisoned food before you eat, purifies 1L of risky water per day on its own.
flavor: You have a FRIEND inside! It eats your food! It cleans your water! It's... rent! Symbiosis! (Don't think about what happens if you starve it!)

deepening.3: Perfect symbiosis: it wants what you want now.

name: Scar Tissue
description: You endured. +10 max health. And your scars itch before danger — once per fight, when you'd drop below 25% HP, the scars remember and hold you at 25% instead.
flavor: The scars are a map of everywhere you almost died. They refuse to add a new pin.

deepening.3: You cannot be outlasted: hunger and cold break first.

name: Wanderlust
description: You kept moving. -10% travel cost. But you can't sit still — resting in one place more than 2 day parts gives you the itch (-5 morale); arriving somewhere new: +5 morale.
flavor: The horizon is a personal insult you intend to answer.

deepening.3: The world provides: you never arrive empty-handed.

name: Swimmer
description: Cross water freely. Rivers are roads to you.
flavor: WE NEVER THOUGHT OF SWIMMING. The water is just... there? And you go IN it?

deepening.3: You are the river: currents carry you where you will.

name: Night Eyes
description: The dark never bothered you. You see shapes in it that others miss — and it never hears you coming.
flavor: THE DARK IS JUST... SLOW LIGHT? You see it anyway. Rude. We were going to sell that.

deepening.3: You see in perfect dark: night is your country.

name: Translator
description: The System logs every foreign word you hear and replays them on demand — a memory aid, not a shortcut. Novel speech stays novel until YOU learn it. (Deep integration may wake it up further.)
flavor: OH WE LOVE THIS ONE! Every word! Logged! Replayable! Like a little notebook! In your HEAD! The full translating part comes later. Probably. We're working on it!

deepening.3: You speak the unsaid: meaning beyond words.

name: Field Medicine
description: Clean wounds, poultice infections, set bones in the field. Heal 20 HP (once per day part). Treat wound sickness; deepened, you can work on others and read infection unnamed. Real wounds only — Blood Price cuts are missing mass and knit ~10 a night.

deepening.2: You can work on others now — treat sick villagers, not just yourself. (Costs you 150 kcal: food becomes healing.)
deepening.3: Your hands know infection — bacterial sicknesses yield to you even unnamed.

name: Herbal Remedy
description: You know which plants draw fever out. Treat the sick — cure some sicknesses outright, ease others; the proud ones need a name first. Master it and they won't.

deepening.2: Your teas bite deeper — easing lasts 5 day-parts, not 3.
deepening.3: MASTER HERBALIST: you read sickness like a book. Your cures no longer need a diagnosis first.

name: Purify
description: The System’s clean touch, borrowed: poison unravels at your gesture. Not charcoal and time — intention, from something that never needed to eat.

deepening.2: Your purifications hold — treated water stays safe for days.
deepening.3: MASTER: you purify at scale — a whole barrel in the time of a cup.

actions.effect: Read the fight as it moves. +2 speed for the rest of the fight (turn order re-sorts from next round).
actions.name: Read the Fight

name: Brawler's Instinct
description: You read a fight as it moves. The body tells you what the mouth won't.
synergyHints: With Adrenaline Control: act first, hit hard

deepening.2: You act first in every fight.
deepening.3: You see the killing blow before they do.

name: Adrenaline Control
description: Your heart hammers — and every hammering beat lands 30% harder. Fear is fuel.
synergyHints: Brawler's Instinct: steady the surge first, then throw it all into one strike.

deepening.3: You fight through pain. Wounds don't slow you.

actions.effect: Lock eyes with an enemy (choose target). 50% chance it backs off and disengages. Fearless foes are immune.
actions.name: Stare Down
End It Before It Starts
actions.effect: Your reputation walks in before you do. You make your point without raising a hand — the dispute ends here. They will remember the look, and not fondly. (-5 trust with the target. Once a day.)

name: Intimidating Presence
description: You don't have to fight. Most people decide not to, just looking at you.

deepening.2: Most back down. Some join you.
deepening.3: Monsters hesitate. They feel you.

name: Silver Tongue
description: Words are tools. You've got a whole workshop.

deepening.2: You can talk your way out of anything.
deepening.3: People believe you. Even when they shouldn't.

name: Gossip Network
description: You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.

deepening.2: You hear everything. Nothing is secret.
deepening.3: Travelers seek you out with news.

name: Peacemaker
description: You can walk into a fight and walk out with friends. It's a gift.

actions.name: Walk In
actions.effect: Walk into a fight and attempt to end it peacefully. Talk check with deescalate bonus. If it fails, you are exposed.

actions.name: Make Friends
actions.effect: Turn a tense social situation friendly. You walk in, you walk out with friends. It is a gift.

deepening.3: Warring villages ask you to mediate.

name: Tireless Stride
description: You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.

deepening.2: Every step costs less. Distance shrinks.
deepening.3: Distance is a rumor.

name: Eagle Eye
description: You see the ruin on the horizon. The smoke. The movement. Before anyone else. Distant finds come easier.

deepening.2: Rare finds catch your eye while foraging.
deepening.3: The odd one out finds you more often now.

name: Lie Detector
description: The mouth says one thing. The hands say another. You watch the hands.
synergyHints: Open Book: catch the flicker, then read what the room does with it.

deepening.2: You catch most lies. The hands always tell.
deepening.3: You know WHY they're lying.

name: Evidence Board
description: You keep track. Who said what, when. The contradictions surface.

deepening.3: You reconstruct events from fragments.

name: Pyrokinesis
description: You coax flame from stubborn fuel. Fires you tend burn hotter and catch easier.
flavor: The System filed this under 'thermodynamic enthusiasm.' You just call it warm hands.

deepening.3: You are the flame: fire obeys your mood.

synergyHints: Ambush: the ground is picked. Now wait.
Nowhere Man: move unseen, build the streak.
Soft Step: weather doesn't get hit.
name: Stalk
description: Move unseen. Close distance without being noticed.
flavor: You're not invisible. You're just not interesting enough to look at twice.

actions.name: Stalk
actions.effect: Move to adjacent tile unseen. Animals don't flee. Once per approach.

deepening.3: You become landscape: watching eyes slide off you.

synergyHints: Trophy Room: the marked don't get away.
Game Sense: read the sign, follow the blood.
Dead Aim: the first shot is a promise kept.
name: Blood Trail
description: You can follow a wounded animal through anything. It doesn't get away.
flavor: The blood tells you everything: how deep, how fast, how long it has.

actions.name: Follow Blood Trail
actions.effect: Track a wounded animal to its location. Reveals direction and distance.

deepening.2: Old blood speaks as loud as fresh.
deepening.3: You follow trails days cold — the land remembers, and so do you.

synergyHints: Stalk: unseen to the ground you picked.
Scarecrow: lure them to your ground.
Dead Aim: wait, then end it.
name: Ambush
description: Pick your ground. Wait. Strike when it's too late for them.
flavor: Patience is a weapon. The best trap is the one they walk into.

actions.name: Ambush
actions.effect: Spend turn preparing. Next attack is 2x damage — they never see it coming.

actions.name: Lay in Wait
actions.effect: Set an ambush at your location. Next animal encounter starts with you hidden.

deepening.2: You don't set ambushes. You become them.
deepening.3: Your ambushes are perfect: the enemy never gets a first turn.

name: Animal Ken
description: You understand animals. Not talk to them — understand them.
flavor: It's not magic. It's just paying attention for ten thousand hours.

actions.name: Read the Beast
actions.effect: Study an animal. Learn if it's hungry, afraid, aggressive, or sick.

actions.name: Calm
actions.effect: Attempt to calm a non-predatory animal. May end the fight peacefully.

deepening.2: Their moods are weather — readable, predictable.
deepening.3: You know what an animal will do before it does. All of them.

name: Water Breathing
description: You can breathe underwater. Gills, magic, or just really good lungs — the System doesn't explain.
flavor: The System filed this under 'respiratory flexibility.' You just call it not drowning.

actions.name: Dive Deep
actions.effect: Explore underwater areas. Find things others can't reach.

deepening.3: You belong below: the water hides and feeds you.

name: Trade of Blows
description: Trade damage like currency. You can afford the exchange rate.
flavor: Every hit you take is a hit you're about to give back with interest.

actions.name: Open the Trade
actions.effect: Take 10 damage voluntarily. Your next 3 attacks deal +50% damage. The pain focuses you.

actions.name: Settle the Debt
actions.effect: Cash in: deal bonus damage equal to 50% of damage taken this fight. Once per fight.

deepening.2: Every exchange teaches. You learn faster than they hit.
deepening.3: You turn their strength against them: their hits open your counters.

name: Unbreakable
description: You don't go down. Not today. Not ever, if you have anything to say about it.
flavor: The System filed a complaint about your pain receptors. You filed it under 'suggestions.'

actions.name: Brace
actions.effect: Plant your feet. Reduce next incoming damage by 60%.

actions.name: Shake It Off
actions.effect: Clear stun, slow, and bleed. Once per fight. Costs 50 kcal — your body burns fuel to keep going.

deepening.2: Pain is information. You read it and keep going.
deepening.3: You cannot be broken: once per fight, ignore what would drop you.

synergyHints: Hunting Spear: three hits sings the cry free.
Intimidating Presence: some reconsider. Some run.
Crowd Favorite: the audience chants with you.
name: War Cry
description: A sound from somewhere older than language. Things that hear it reconsider.
flavor: It's not the volume. It's the promise.

actions.name: War Cry
actions.effect: All enemies must pass a courage check or lose their next turn. Beasts may flee outright.

actions.name: Issue Challenge
actions.effect: Issue a public dare to a villager: a non-lethal bout, witnessed. The dare stands until hands are thrown — and when they are, the village holds you both to the terms: to yield, winner takes respect, loser takes humility. Break the terms (a killing) and the village names you oathbreaker. Once a day.

deepening.2: Your voice is a weapon now.
deepening.3: Your cry is legend: enemies break before the fighting starts.

synergyHints: Rage: start angry, end everything.
Blood Frenzy: the chain's finale.
Dead Aim: patience, then thunder, then THIS.
name: Haymaker
description: One big swing. Everything you have, all at once. Subtlety is for people with time.
flavor: The windup is the telegraph. The landing is the punctuation.

actions.name: Haymaker
actions.effect: A massive swing: 2.5x damage, but -30% accuracy. If it misses, you're off-balance (enemies get +hit next turn).

deepening.2: The big swing always lands where it hurts.
deepening.3: One perfect blow: your haymaker can end a fight outright.

description: Your nose changed days ago. Water has a smell now — and so does fear. You haven’t told anyone. People look at you funny when you find things by smell.
memory: You found {kin}’s lost tools by smell alone, near {place}. A week ago you couldn’t have. Nobody can explain it. You’ve stopped trying to.
name: Bloodhound

deepening.3: You smell truth: fear, lies, and water, all distinct.

description: Animals started going quiet around you this week. Not tame — listening. Like they’re waiting to see what you’ll do.
memory: The mean dog at {place} — the one that bit everyone — let you touch it yesterday. {kin} saw. {kin} hasn’t looked at you quite the same way since.
name: Beast-calm

deepening.3: Beasts know you: predators stand down in your presence.

description: Days ago the plants started leaning toward you. You know which ones are thirsty, which are sick, which are hiding something good. You don’t know how you know.
memory: {kin} watched you press your palm to dry soil at {place} and find water underneath. ‘How?’ they asked. You didn’t have an answer. You still don’t.
name: Green Whisper

deepening.3: The green obeys: you can coax growth from bare ground.

description: Your stomach changed this week. Things that should lay you flat barely slow you down now. You noticed. You haven’t told anyone.
memory: At {place}, {kin} watched you eat something that should have put you in the ground. You were fine by morning. The story’s already getting bigger. Your stomach stayed the same.
name: Iron Gut

deepening.3: You can eat anything: poison is just spice to you now.

description: The dark stopped bothering you days ago. You see shapes in it that others miss — movement, mostly. You’re always watching the movement now.
memory: You sat up at {place} watching the dark. {kin} asked what you were looking at. ‘Everything,’ you said. A month ago you couldn’t see your own hand.
name: Night Eyes

deepening.3: You see in perfect dark: night is your country.

description: Your feet learned something this week. Even in places you’ve never been, they find the cheap miles on their own. You don’t think about it. You don’t have to.
memory: You walked {kin} home through {place} in the dark — no map, no light, and arrived with breath to spare. ‘How?’ Your feet didn’t answer. Neither did you.
name: Waywise

deepening.2: Every step costs less. Distance shrinks.
deepening.3: The land is short under your feet.

description: Your hands stopped shaking this week. Not when you’re scared, not when it matters. They just do the work now.
memory: {kin} watched you work and went quiet. ‘Your hands don’t shake,’ they said, like it was a question. A month ago they did. You didn’t have an answer.
name: Still Hands

deepening.3: Your hands never fail: the delicate impossible is routine.

description: You feel weather coming in your bones now — a day out. It started this week. You’re always ready, every vessel out. Catch 50% more rainwater.
memory: {kin} laughed when you called rain under a clear sky. Then the rain came. They stopped laughing. You’ve only been right since Tuesday.
name: Storm-ear

deepening.3: The sky speaks: you know storms days ahead, and their moods.

description: Wounds close a little faster when your hands are on them now. Not miracles — just faster. It started days ago. You don’t know why. You’ve stopped asking.
memory: When {kin} got hurt at {place}, your hands just knew where to press. They looked at you funny after. A week ago your hands were just hands.
name: The Touch

deepening.3: Hands that heal and know: you feel sickness like a texture.

description: The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
flavor: Pop it in, never chew again! We FIXED eating! One per world, first come first served, no take-backsies! ...Why are you looking at us like that? We FIXED it!
name: Fusion Reactor

deepening.2: The reactor runs cleaner: the fire steadies, the hum fades into background.
deepening.3: You forget what hunger felt like. You are not sure what else you forgot.

synergyHints: Retribution: their hits charge YOUR weapon.
Bodyguard: step into it. Store it. Return it.
Rally: when it's lost, be the wall.
name: Draw Fire
description: In the wilds, beside your people, you make yourself the problem. Shout, wave, bleed loudly — the beast's eye stays on you and off them. Monsters focus you instead of your allies.
flavor: Me. I'm the problem. Come and take.

deepening.2: Your challenge carries further. Beasts hear it first.
deepening.3: You are the wall it breaks on. Everyone knows it, especially the wall.

synergyHints: Leech: take half. They owe you.
Retribution: their blow is your ammunition.
Battlefield Grace: three touches and they're back.
name: Bodyguard
description: In the wilds, when a blow is falling on someone beside you, you step into it. Once per fight, an attack meant for your ally lands on you instead. It hurts. That's the job.
flavor: Not them.

deepening.2: You read the blow a breath earlier.
deepening.3: Your people stop flinching when things fall. They know where you'll be.

synergyHints: Retribution: brace as one, charge as one.
Bodyguard: the wall has a door.
Draw Fire: the wall IS the problem.
name: Shield Wall
description: Shoulder to shoulder in the wilds, you brace as one. While an ally fights beside you, blows that reach you land softer — the line holds together or not at all.
flavor: Hold the line.

deepening.2: The line tightens. Less gets through.
deepening.3: You have been the wall so long you've forgotten what it was like to stand alone.

name: Rally
description: In the wilds, when the fight is lost and running would be sane, you look at the people standing with you and you do not run. Once per fight, when the trajectory turns hopeless and an ally stands beside you, you hold the line instead of fleeing. Not volume — a promise kept.
flavor: For them.

deepening.2: Your voice finds them faster in the noise.
deepening.3: They have heard you hold before. They believe it now.

name: Static Toss
description: You ball up the static in your palm and THROW it. It was going to go somewhere anyway. (Ranged: 3 tiles, energy damage, once per fight.)
flavor: The System applauds your commitment to throwing problems at other problems.

actions.name: Toss Static
actions.desc: Hurl static 3 tiles for [20,30] energy damage.

deepening.2: The static sticks — the struck monster is slowed (moves 1 less) for 2 rounds.
deepening.3: CHAIN LIGHTNING: arcs to a second monster for half damage.

name: Screaming Cheese Wheel
description: You hurl a wheel of screaming cheese. It homes in on the loudest thing in the fight — usually the monster. (Ranged: can't miss, 1/day.)
flavor: The cheese screams the whole way there. It has range anxiety.

actions.name: Hurl Cheese Wheel
actions.desc: Homing cheese wheel: [25,35] damage, can't miss, 1/day.

deepening.2: The wheel is aged — it stuns for 1 round on impact (the smell).
deepening.3: The wheel multiplies mid-flight. Two wheels. Twice the screaming.

name: Bird Strike
description: You point at the sky. The birds have been waiting for this. (Ranged: birds dive-bomb a monster for 3 rounds.)
flavor: The birds were already circling. They just needed permission.

actions.name: Call the Birds
actions.desc: Birds harry a monster for 3 rounds: [8,12]/round, 20% blind chance.

deepening.3: The birds learn to aim for eyes. 40% blind chance.

name: Tripwire
description: You string a wire at ankle height. The next monster that moves eats dirt — prone, stunned, and embarrassed. (Sets up the party.)
flavor: The wire is almost invisible. The monster's dignity is not.

actions.name: String Tripwire
actions.desc: Next monster that moves: prone (stun 1 + no move next turn).

deepening.2: Barbed wire. The prone monster also bleeds.
deepening.3: Two wires. Two monsters. Twice the embarrassment.

name: Turncoat
description: You explain to them, very reasonably, why the OTHER monster is the real problem. For 2 rounds, they believe you. (Monsters fight each other.)
flavor: Your argument is airtight. It helps that they're monsters.

actions.name: Turn Them
actions.desc: Two monsters fight each other for 2 rounds. Needs 2+ monsters.

deepening.3: They hold a grudge. The feud persists after the fight (they'll remember).

name: Freeze Tag
description: You touch it and yell 'YOU'RE IT!' It can't move until someone tags it back — and nobody's playing. (Root 2 rounds.)
flavor: The rules are clear. The monster didn't agree to them, but the rules are clear.

actions.name: Tag It
actions.desc: Root a monster in place for 2 rounds. It can still attack adjacent.

deepening.2: No tag-backs: also silences its special for 1 round.
deepening.3: Everyone's it: root all adjacent monsters.

synergyHints: Machete: with the blade, your shove PULLS.
Hogtie: shove them prone, then tie them.
Blood Frenzy: the hit counts. Keep hitting.
name: Shoulder Check
description: You know exactly where to hit something with your shoulder so it goes where YOU want. Shove a controlled monster 2 tiles — into its friends, away from yours.
flavor: It's all in the shoulder. The System watched a bouncer once and took NOTES.

actions.name: Shoulder Check
actions.effect: Shove a controlled (stunned/rooted/bound/blinded/hesitating) size-1 monster 2 tiles directly away from you. Slamming it into another fighter deals collision to both.

deepening.3: You can shoulder-check a door off its hinges. You've done it. Twice.

synergyHints: Phase Blade: bind without rope.
Turncoat: tie one, convince the other.
Retribution: buy time to charge.
name: Hogtie
description: Rope, a dazed monster, and thirty seconds of not being eaten. Hogtie a controlled monster: rooted 3 rounds (diminishing), and it can't wind up telegraphs. It can still lash out — the rope holds position, not malice.
flavor: The System is VERY proud of this one. It watched a rodeo. It has opinions about knots now.

actions.name: Hogtie
actions.effect: Spend 1 rope + the action on a controlled monster: rooted 3 rounds (3→2→1 per previous bind), cannot start telegraphs while bound. Uninterruptible monsters still attack — the rope holds the body, not the promise.

deepening.3: You once hogtied a rumor. It stayed tied.

synergyHints: Pocket Sand: blind it first, then call it.
Tripwire: call them into the wire.
Draw Fire: you're already the problem.
name: Come Get Some
description: Make exactly the right noise and the blind thing comes to investigate. Goad a blinded monster within 3 tiles: it lurches toward the sound on its next move. Stand where you want it.
flavor: It's not the words. It's the TONE. The System has been practicing.

actions.name: Come Get Some
actions.effect: Target a blinded monster within 3 tiles: it lurches toward your position on its next move. Reposition the threat without touching it.

deepening.2: You can goad a statue into flinching.
deepening.3: Your taunts have a return address.

name: Blood Frenzy
description: Each consecutive successful strike in a fight: Land 2 consecutive hits and the next is a guaranteed crit (double damage, costs 50 kcal). Miss and the count resets. The red doesn't come down — it builds.
flavor: OH. OH NO. THE AUDIENCE IS COUNTING. THREE! FOUR! DON'T YOU DARE MISS!
synergyHints: Rage: start the chain angry.
Haymaker: end the chain with everything.
Pocket Sand: they can't dodge what they can't see.

deepening.3: Missing no longer fully breaks it — halves instead.

name: Retribution
description: Store blocked damage. UNLEASH (active): release it as a shockwave hitting all adjacent enemies — but you keep 25% of the pain. The wall hits back, and it hits you too.
flavor: YOU ATE THEIR BEST SHOT. NOW SERVE IT BACK.

actions.name: Unleash Retribution
actions.effect: The System returns your recorded pain as force — shockwave to all adjacent enemies.

synergyHints: Shield Wall: brace as one, charge as one.
Bodyguard: their hits charge YOUR weapon.
Draw Fire: make yourself the problem, then answer it.

deepening.3: Unleash also staggers.

name: Trophy Room
description: Once per day, mark a monster type you have killed. +50% damage against the marked type. The hunter's memory is a weapon.
flavor: THE WALL OF HEADS GROWS. EACH ONE TEACHES THE NEXT ONE HOW TO DIE.

actions.name: Mark Trophy
actions.effect: Choose a slain monster type to mark for +50% damage today.

synergyHints: Game Sense: know what's been here, then hunt it.
Blood Trail: the wounded don't get away. The marked don't either.
Dead Aim: the first shot is a promise.

deepening.3: Two marks per day.

name: Feast Engine
description: While at full health: +25% damage. The body is a furnace at full burn. Stay topped up, hit harder.
flavor: FULL? FULL IS A STARTING POINT. THE EXCESS HAS TO GO SOMEWHERE. WE SUGGEST: OUTWARD.
synergyHints: Blood Magic: eat yourself to feed the engine. (We said it was a furnace.)
Iron Gut: waste nothing.
Molt: shed, heal full, ignite.

name: Battlefield Grace
description: Heal the same ally 3 times in one fight: they gain an immediately usable free action. Care is tempo.
flavor: THREE TOUCHES AND THEY'RE BACK ON THEIR FEET MID-SWING. THE AUDIENCE IS CRYING. WE'RE CRYING.
synergyHints: The Touch: faster hands, faster grace.
Leech: take their pain, then give them the turn.
Field Medicine: the basics, perfected.

deepening.3: Also grants +1 round of courage.

name: Nowhere Man
description: +5% dodge per tile moved without taking damage, stacking to +40%. Getting hit resets it. You were never there.
flavor: THE CAMERAS CAN'T TRACK YOU. WE CHECKED. THE REPLAY IS JUST WIND.
synergyHints: Soft Step: weather doesn't get hit.
Stalk: close distance, keep the streak.
Time Skip: reposition, keep moving.

name: Cartographer's Eye
description: +1% dodge per 10 revealed map tiles in your current region, up to +15%. You know where the ground is uneven, where the cover is. They don't.
flavor: YOU'VE WALKED EVERY MILE OF THIS. THE LAND FIGHTS WITH YOU NOW.
synergyHints: Echo Location: sense the land, then weaponize it.
Hive Mind: the map is the territory is the arsenal.
Eagle Eye: see it first, own it first.

name: Crowd Favorite
description: Your social abilities scale with your audience: effects ×(1 + fans/10). The crowd is a resource. Work it.
flavor: THEY'RE CHANTING YOUR NAME. WE TAUGHT THEM. YOU'RE WELCOME. NOW USE IT.
synergyHints: Silver Tongue: the workshop, with an audience.
War Cry: they hear it. They ALWAYS hear it now.
Gossip Network: the crowd talks. You listen.

name: Hoarder's Interest
description: Your stored pantry resources generate 5% per day as bonus calories, compounding. Patience is an engine.
flavor: INTEREST! ON GRAIN! THE ECONOMY IS REAL AND IT IS HUNGRY FOR YOUR PATIENCE.
synergyHints: Hoarder: carry it all. Store it all. Earn on it all.
Deep Reserves: the war chest pays dividends.
Thief: acquire capital by any means.

deepening.3: 2% per day.

name: Cornucopia
description: Consecutive successful forages: +15% yield each, stacking to +150%. Fail, or do anything else, and the streak breaks. The land rewards devotion.
flavor: THE BASKET OVERFLOWS. THE BASKET HAS ALWAYS OVERFLOWED. YOU JUST FINALLY NOTICED.
synergyHints: Green Thumb: ask the plant, then take 15% more.
Green Whisper: they lean toward you. Lean back harder.
Dowsing: water finds the devoted.
